children: Overview
Italy winding wires maker's H1 2026 consolidated revenue grew 9.4% yr/yr, driven by higher copper prices
Net income for H1 2026 rose yr/yr amid weak market demand and declining sales volumes
Company cited loss of sales from Dutch subsidiary closure and difficulties in automotive, appliance markets
Outlook
Company says ongoing conflicts and rising costs are creating uncertainty for market prospects
IRCE continues rationalization efforts and medium- to long-term growth strategy in energy transition sectors
Output continues to increase at Czech plant; system installations underway in China
Result Drivers
COPPER PRICES - Co said revenue growth was driven by higher copper prices, despite declining sales volumes
MARKET DEMAND - Co cited weak demand and declining sales volumes across business lines, especially in automotive and appliance sectors
SUBSIDIARY CLOSURE - Co said loss of sales from Dutch subsidiary closure contributed to winding wires segment decline
